Roi.debris_clearance: Limited clearance begins under local security on 7-8 Feb and accelerates after 9-Feb secure closeout.
Roi.emergency_liaison_fighter_use: 11-13 Feb centered; individual liaison, emergency and limited fighter landings are possible before full squadron throughput.
Roi.limited_CAP_ferry_recon_detachment: 13-15 Feb centered, constrained by debris, UXO, fuel handling, maintenance space and traffic control.
Roi.regular_fighter_squadron_level_ops: 16-18 Feb working gate; not yet a mature high-throughput bomber base.
Roi.longer_term: Major reconstruction, parking, supply and sustained multi-type base expansion continue for weeks/months.

Kwajalein_Island.clearance_start: 9 Feb after formal secure declaration; selected engineer work starts earlier where locally safe.
Kwajalein_Island.limited_staging: 15-19 Feb centered for transport/recon/light-medium staging as surfaces, fuel and traffic control permit.
Kwajalein_Island.guard: Do not treat the captured strip as a mature bomber base immediately after repair of a usable landing surface.

Ebeye_water_air.state: Seaplane ramps/piers/support facilities are damaged but lagoon geography remains useful.
Ebeye_water_air.limited_PBY_tender_ASW_recon_use: 11-14 Feb centered using mobile/tender support plus repaired local facilities.
Ebeye_water_air.effect: Improves local ASW/recon persistence and logistics liaison without requiring a fully reconstructed permanent seaplane base.

Majuro: Remains the preferred immediate fast-fleet replenishment/assembly node; Kwajalein does not instantly replace it.
